title: One operator owns a Plan while implementors deliver
statement: As a developer I run one operator agent that owns a Plan and its record and delegates the work, so implementing agents focus on delivery and the record stays consistent

acceptance_criteria.statement: plan guide and the skill recommend one operator agent that owns a Plan and delegates the Tasks that can start to implementing agents
The guidance tells implementing agents to deliver on their own branch and report what they did to the operator, running no change-saga command and keeping no Saga
The guidance says the operator records implementors' progress, marks a Task done once its work is merged into its branch, and passes and merges checkpoints
The guidance tells the operator to keep the live Plan open with change-saga serve, to see where things stand
